reasoning: Read both sides. AtomVecEllipsoid::process_args (src/atom_vec_ellipsoid.cpp:1089-1120) accepts 'superellipsoid', sets atom->superellipsoid_flag and atom->radius_flag, raises size_border_bonus/size_restart_bonus_one to 13, appends 'radius' to fields_grow/copy/border/border_vel/exchange/restart/create and calls setup_fields(). Atom::create_avec calls avec->process_args(narg,arg) unconditionally (src/atom.cpp:695), so 'atom_style ellipsoid/kk superellipsoid' reaches it. grep for 'super' in src/KOKKOS/atom_vec_ellipsoid_kokkos.{cpp,h} returns nothing: the KOKKOS class neither overrides process_args nor knows about bonus_super, hard-codes size_exchange_bonus = 8 in the ctor (line 39), and its bonus pack/unpack functors move exactly shape[3]+quat[4]. Worse, AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos::grow() (lines 74-105) has a hand-written, fixed list of memoryKK->grow_kokkos calls (tag,type,mask,image,x,v,f,rmass,angmom,torque,ellipsoid) that ignores fields_grow entirely, so atomKK->k_radius is never allocated, while AtomVecKokkos::set_atom_masks() (atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:2999-3003) folds field2mask('radius') into datamask_border and AtomVecKokkos_PackBorder does 'if (_datamask & RADIUS_MASK) _buf(i,m++) = static_cast<double>(_radius(j));' (atom_vec_kokkos.cpp:1534-1535) on that zero-extent view. Nothing rejects or compensates for the option.
fix: Add an AtomVecEllipsoidKokkos::process_args override that calls error->all(FLERR,"Atom style ellipsoid/kk does not support the 'superellipsoid' option") for that argument (and otherwise forwards to AtomVecEllipsoid::process_args), until the 13-wide bonus_super layout and k_radius growth are implemented.
